notes: Prefill tested at S=202751, the longest valid non-aligned logical length; the final position 202751 is exercised through the paged decode path attending the full cache. Together they cover all 202752 positions.
Layer 47 of the checkpoint is the MTP (num_nextn_predict_layers) head; HF's Glm4MoeLiteForCausalLM drops it via _keys_to_ignore_on_load_unexpected, so it is outside the decoder contract.

Decode batch tested up to 32 users (one decode row tile). paged_update_cache is issued in <=16-user groups because its per-core static CBs scale with B*Wt and exceed Blackhole L1 at 32 users x 576 latent width.

fused_decoder.kv_cache_contract: identical to functional_decoder (same paged latent cache ops, dtype, block size, allocation)
fused_decoder.weight_footprint_delta: adds a per-head copy of wq_b for prefill (+7.9 MB bf16 per layer, ~0.36 GiB over 47 layers); wqkv_a replaces wq_a+wkv_a and packed gate_up replaces gate+up at identical byte counts; full-model weights_bf4_experts_bf8_rest_gib_approx 18.5 -> ~18.9, still fits 32 GiB with the bf8 latent cache (5.8 GiB) at batch 1

full_model_projection.fits_32gib_single_chip: yes at batch 1 with bf4 experts and bf8 (or bf16) latent cache
full_model_projection.mha_style_cache_context_ceiling_at_12gib: ~13k tokens - why the latent-cache contract is mandatory
